Draft Notice: System Maintenance Schedule

hey team so basically we are doing maintenance on server cluster B this Saturday night April 12 2026 starting at 11pm EST until Sunday morning 4am EST. During these 5 hours the customer database DB-02 will be totally offline and people won't be able to log in or process payments. Make sure your teams finish all customer transactions before 10:45pm. If anything breaks call the on-call engineer Mark Spencer at 555-0199 or ping him on Slack @mark.s. Don't push any code releases during this window.

# Official Notice: System Maintenance Schedule

**Scheduled Window:** Saturday, April 12, 2026, 11:00 PM EST – Sunday, April 13, 2026, 4:00 AM EST (5 Hours)

**Impacted Services:**  
Server Cluster B and customer database DB-02 will be completely offline during this 5-hour maintenance window. User authentication and payment processing services will be temporarily unavailable.

**Required Actions:**  
1. **Transaction Cutoff:** Operational teams must complete all pending customer transactions prior to 10:45 PM EST on Saturday, April 12.
2. **Deployment Freeze:** Code deployments and software releases are strictly prohibited throughout the maintenance window.

**Emergency Escalation:**  
For urgent issues during maintenance, contact On-Call Engineer Mark Spencer at **555-0199** or via Slack at **@mark.s**.

Rough Notes: Vendor Contract Renewal Terms

We talked with Apex Data Systems on May 3 2026 about extending their cloud storage contract. The old contract expires June 30 2026. New price is $14500 a month down from $16200 a month because we committed for 3 years instead of 1 year. They give us 100TB storage and 24/7 dedicated support with 15 minute SLA for critical tickets. We have to sign the formal agreement by May 25 2026 to lock in the discount. If we sign late the price goes back to $16200.

# Contract Renewal Terms Summary: Apex Data Systems

**Negotiation Date:** May 3, 2026  
**Current Expiration Date:** June 30, 2026  

**Revised Contract Terms:**  
- **Monthly Commitment:** $14,500 per month (reduced from $16,200 per month).
- **Agreement Term:** 3-year commitment (extended from previous 1-year term).
- **Storage Allocation:** 100TB enterprise cloud storage capacity.
- **Support Level:** 24/7 dedicated support with a guaranteed 15-minute Service Level Agreement (SLA) for critical incidents.

**Execution Deadline:**  
The formal renewal agreement must be executed by **May 25, 2026**, to secure the discounted monthly rate of $14,500. Submissions after this date will revert to the standard rate of $16,200 per month.
